title: Contacts export
body:
## Destination

Provide a project-local command that exports the existing contacts list to CSV.

## Captured user intent

U01 — The user wants to export the existing contacts list without editing contacts.
U02 — The user wants the file saved locally and no network upload.

## Context and sources

This is a fictional format example, not a claim about an inspected project.
The only source for its requirements is the example intent above.

## In scope

Export the current contacts list to one user-selected local CSV file.

## Out of scope

Editing contacts, cloud synchronization, and automatic scheduling.

## Task requirements

### REQ-001 — Export the existing contacts
- Requirement: Export the existing contacts list as a local CSV file.
- Source: U01 — example user intent.
- Acceptance: The exported file contains the existing contacts without changing their source records.
- Depends on: None.

### REQ-002 — Keep the export local
- Requirement: Save the CSV at the local path selected by the user without uploading it.
- Source: U02 — example user intent.
- Acceptance: The file exists at the selected local path and the export operation makes no network upload.
- Depends on: REQ-001
